messages:
Maya (People Ops): Hi @Jordan — attached a compact manager + HR checklist for Liam's first week. Tried to make it checklist-style for easy copy/paste into calendar invites and hiring tracker. Please flag owners.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks Maya. I can own code walkthrough, pairing schedule, and 30/60/90 review.

Maya (People Ops): Core first-week checklist (paste into onboarding doc):

1) Pre-start (48h before): laptop shipped, SSO invite, Slack & calendar access, badge request submitted.
2) Day 1 AM: HR intro (payroll, benefits), manager expectation 1:1 (role context, immediate priorities).
3) Day 1 PM: team standup + intro round, mentor assignment, verify VPN/badge.
4) Day 2: product roadmap + customer context, architecture docs + read-only repo access.
5) Day 3: dev workflow & PR process, CI run + local dev pairing, assign first small ticket.
6) Day 4: observability / alerts + deploy runbook, security checklist + access to staging keys (if needed).
7) Day 5: week-1 review, set 30-day outcomes, schedule 30/60/90 checkpoint meetings.

Short manager checklist (copyable):
- Before start: confirm mentor and pairing owner, create calendar blocks for 1:1s (weekly x 1h first month).
- Week 1: shadow first deploy, review 1st PR together, set 3 measurable 30-day outcomes.
- 30d: merged change to staging, completed security checklist, met product + support owners.
- 60d: owned a small feature/bug end-to-end, presented to team, improved CI test where possible.
- 90d: delivered measurable improvement (perf/latency/error rate) or proposed a process change.

Jordan (Eng Manager): I'll add 1:1 cadence as weekly 1:1 + biweekly skip-level. Mentor will be Priya — pairing scheduled Mon/Tue.

Liam (New Hire): Quick Q: what's the normal route for getting repo write access?

Ravi (IT): Typical flow: manager requests in eng-perms channel -> we approve -> CI group adds to team. If you see 403, ping me with a screenshot. For VPN issues use: `vpn-status --check` (internal tool) and attach logs.

Nina (Security): Security checklist highlights: complete training, sign data handling attestation, request prod access only after 60d unless approved. If urgent, manager must request exception in `security-access` with justification.

Onboarding Bot: Calendar events created: "Liam Week1 HR + Manager 1:1" Mon 09:00, "Repo Walkthrough" Tue 11:00, "Deploy Shadow" Wed 14:00, "Week1 Review" Fri 16:00. Invites sent.

Maya (People Ops): Who-to-ask cheat sheet:
- Hardware / SSO / badge: Ravi (IT)
- Repo / CI perms: Jordan (Manager) -> eng-infra
- Payroll / benefits: Maya (People Ops)
- Security / prod keys: Nina (Security)
- Calendar / invites: Onboarding Bot / People Ops

Jordan (Eng Manager): I'll post the 30/60/90 template in the hiring tracker with owners and acceptance criteria. Anything else?

Liam (New Hire): All good — laptop ETA looks good. Appreciate the clear checklist :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Awesome. I'll post a short welcome message in #general on Friday with a one-line bio. If anything blocks, please ping `#people-ops`.
